# CADE Media

> {{ site.description | strip }} CADE makes cycling videos on YouTube, The Wild Ones weekly cycling podcast, short clips on TikTok and YouTube, and posts on Instagram and Bluesky. Based in the UK.

CADE's team: {% for m in site.data.team %}{{ m.name }} ({{ m.role }}){% unless forloop.last %}, {% endunless %}{% endfor %}.

## Main pages

- [The Feed]({{ '/feed/' | absolute_url }}): every video, podcast episode, clip and update in one timeline, newest first
- [The Wild Ones Podcast]({{ '/wild-ones-podcast/' | absolute_url }}): the weekly podcast on bike tech, industry news and life on two wheels
- [Video]({{ '/video/' | absolute_url }}): YouTube reviews, first looks and rides
- [Clips]({{ '/cade-clips/' | absolute_url }}): short clips from the podcast and channel
- [The Cool Wall]({{ '/cool-wall/' | absolute_url }}): CADE's (unscientific) ranking of the bike tech they review
- [Contact]({{ '/contact-us/' | absolute_url }}): podcast questions, commercial and PR enquiries
